A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dominant follicle has the capacity to produce estrdiol, inhibins and IGFBPs, and that these factors may be involved in the selection of the dominant follicle.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the dominant follicle is selected by a combination of factors, not just by a single factor.
follicle selection in the bovine is a dynamic and complex process, and the follicular environment changes throughout the first follicular wave.
